THE RULEBOOK

Five signings.
Make them count.

  1. Toss for first bid. A 50/50 coin toss picks Player 1 or Player 2. The opening bidder alternates after each auction.
  2. Spin to reveal. A random footballer appears with their position and attributes.
  3. Take turns bidding. Start at $1 or pass. Raise by $1 or go all in until your opponent passes. Both pass? The player goes unsold.
  4. Unlimited bidding passes. Three solo skips. Pass freely while both managers can buy. Once your opponent has $0 or a full squad, you have 3 solo skips for the entire match. After those are used, sign the revealed player for $1 or more. Signing does not refill your skips. This applies in both modes.
  5. Go all in. Each manager has $20, and can bid their full remaining balance. At $0, you wait while the other manager finishes bidding or skipping players. Once neither manager can buy more, spin one random unclaimed free signing at a time until both squads are full. Free picks are final and can land out of position.
  6. Build any five. The game finds your best lineup: one attacker, two midfielders, one defender and one keeper. Signing a keeper is optional. Goalkeepers have double the draw weight in auctions and free picks. That improves your chances, but neither team is guaranteed a keeper. Draws do not target missing positions.
  7. Highest rating wins. Your five adjusted slot ratings are averaged. No random match result; an exact tie is a draw.

THE FINAL SCORE

How ratings work

Stats & position penalties

The large card number is the player’s overall ability rating. Card attributes are displayed as recorded. Outfield players show pace, shooting, passing, dribbling, defending and physical; keepers show diving, handling, kicking, reflexes, speed and positioning.

Any listed position group keeps 100% of the overall rating. Attacker ↔ midfielder or midfielder ↔ defender keeps 80%; attacker ↔ defender keeps 60%. A keeper outfield keeps 35%. An outfield player in goal uses the average of their five recorded goalkeeping attributes; Legends without keeper attributes receive a fixed 10. Those position adjustments are our game rules.

We choose the highest-scoring assignment to 1 ATT, 2 MID, 1 DEF and 1 GK, then average the five adjusted ratings. Empty slots count as zero while drafting. Same score means a draw.

All bids are fictional. Refreshing starts over.

THE PLAYER POOL

Realistic player ratings.

Current Players brings together 100 handpicked stars and familiar favourites from Europe’s top five leagues.

All-Time Players mixes 100 recognizable names across generations: legends, fan favourites and memorable underdogs. Existing season ratings are kept unchanged.

Player attributes describe their ability. Our position-fit rules determine how those ratings contribute to your five-a-side team.
